newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical begins Cariel trial.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical begins Cariel trial.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said it has started a clinical trial in Europe of its Cariel topical wound healing gel, derived from the company's in-situ tissue culturing technology.
It said the trial, scheduled to be completed in the fourth quarter, is designed to provide the clinical data in support of the company's European regulatory submission.
The trial will measure the gel's efficacy in healing venous stasis ulcers without the use of conventional treatment known as compression therapy.
Used in this manner, Life Medical said, Cariel offers the potential for significant savings in the estimated $2 billion expended annually for the care of these wounds.
